parameters.apprise_url_plus: twilio://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.account_sid_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.auth_token_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_phone_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-twilio-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Twilio destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Twilio destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: To=${ customer_secrets.TWILIO_SMS_TO }&From=${ customer_secrets.TWILIO_SMS_FROM }&Body={* ((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Twilio destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Twilio number
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Twilio destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

account_sid_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twilio account sid

auth_token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twilio auth token

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twilio from phone
